content: Samar Ghosh contacted DCoders Insurance regarding a missing confirmation email for life policy LIF-009823. After reviewing the policy, agent Anita Sharma identified a technical glitch causing a delay in activation, as the policy was promised to be active the previous day. Anita assured Samar that a confirmation email with policy details would be sent within the next hour and escalated the issue to the technical team for immediate resolution.

action_items: Escalate technical glitch to the technical team
Send confirmation email with policy details within the next hour
